summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of CrewIQ Home Edition. Wrote 21 pytest cases covering auth (admin/member/PIN validation), onboarding, dashboards (admin/user), chores, assignments (start/complete/approve with bonus), transfers (locked-block + accept + admin-approve reassigns owner), messaging, announcements, rewards (redeem + insufficient-points), settings, and admin CRUD on users. All 21 pytest tests pass (100%). Ran Playwright flows against the public preview URL: admin login -> Command Center dashboard renders (pending approvals=1, today's chores=5, crew=3, ranking populated), member PIN login -> 4-step onboarding for minor Willow with guardian checkbox appearing, checkboxes gate Continue/Finish, step 4 -> dashboard, and onboarding not shown on re-login. Missions Start->Complete moves card to Pending. Admin Approvals bonus+comment approval succeeds. Announcement create appears in member Announcements section. Settings save persists free_transfers=2. Member Messaging bubble appears. No critical bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1140 lines. Consider splitting into routers (auth, users, chores, assignments, transfers, messages, rewards, dashboard, seed) for maintainability.
week_bounds() ignores the week_start setting and always uses Monday.

recompute_user() is called but doesn't recompute level/rank based on the current lifetime_points until it does user.get('lifetime_points'). It does. But note: streak_count only increments on approval; there is no decay logic if a day is missed, which may be intentional but should be documented.
public GET /auth/members exposes member IDs and avatars unauthenticated (needed for PIN login screen but could be rate-limited).
Reward redemption decrements quantity without checking approval_required flow; admin cannot reject a redemption (no /redemptions endpoints for admin management).

seed_data_creation: Backend seeds admin + 3 members + areas + 6 chores + assignments + 4 rewards + 1 announcement automatically on startup. Tests reset Willow's and Avery's onboarding via admin endpoint as needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both Avery and Willow onboardings were completed during tests. Garralt's onboarding was also completed during UI test. Use admin reset-onboarding endpoint if you need to retest the onboarding flow. Backend test uses TEST_ prefix and cleans up its own data.
